request.summary: Create a light-first campus wayfinding directory backed by an editable internal table.
request.audience: Rivermark College students, visitors, and staff scanning campus directions from a distance.
request.primaryGoal: Keep building, floor, department, room, direction, and accessibility information easy to scan across landscape, strip, portrait, and square signage.

assumptions: Directory rows are maintained in a Wallboard TABLE and should update without rebuilding the app.
Natural sorting by building, floor, department, room, direction, and accessibility note provides a deterministic order without adding maintenance-only columns.
The directory may rotate automatically when the normalized rows do not fit on one page.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The requested surfaces span full-screen landscape, a wide reader strip, portrait signage, and a compact square placement.

surfaces.purpose: Wide, low-height concourse or lobby signage zone.

settings.purpose: Selects the coordinated Light, Dark, or Custom color scheme.
College name shown in the directory header.
Current directory location or orientation context.
Message shown when the bound table has no valid directory rows.
Seconds each directory page remains visible.

dynamicText.fallback: At the readable minimum, preserve one line and ellipsize only the tail.
dynamicText.rationale: The configurable directory title is the primary orientation label.

dynamicText.fallback: Ellipsize the department tail after preserving its readable prefix, room, and direction.
dynamicText.rationale: Row alignment and a stable scan path are more useful than wrapping one unusually long department across neighboring rows.

dynamicText.fallback: Ellipsize secondary route detail while keeping the direction prefix and arrow visible.
dynamicText.rationale: Directions must stay on the same horizontal scan line as their destination.

dynamicText.fallback: Keep the ACCESS marker visible and ellipsize only the detailed note.
dynamicText.rationale: Accessibility guidance remains identifiable even when its optional note is long.

dynamicText.fallback: Paginate before reducing or clipping the destination name.
dynamicText.rationale: Portrait rows use vertical space to keep each destination readable in the scan path.

dynamicText.fallback: Paginate before reducing or clipping primary route guidance.
dynamicText.rationale: Directions are primary wayfinding data and must remain complete on portrait signage.

dynamicText.fallback: Paginate before reducing or clipping accessibility guidance.
dynamicText.rationale: Accessibility guidance is primary wayfinding data and must remain complete on portrait signage.

states.expectation: The coordinated dark preset preserves hierarchy and contrast.
Custom semantic colors remain coordinated and readable.
One building uses the full directory without redundant repeated cards.
Many building and floor groups remain ordered and paginated.
Large and small floor groups preserve a continuous scan path.
Long departments, directions, and accessibility notes remain bounded at the wide-low target.
Long destination, direction, and accessibility values wrap completely at readable sizes on portrait signage.
Missing room values use a clear fallback without dropping otherwise valid rows.
Representative fictional directory content is shown before a datasource is selected.
An explicit calm empty state replaces the row area.
Malformed rows are skipped while valid entries continue rendering.
Processed row-array output normalizes to the same typed directory model.
The last page is balanced and uses the available row area without clipping or top compression.
A table edit updates the visible directory without rebuilding the app.

behaviors.expectation: Rows sort naturally by building, floor, department, room, direction, and accessibility note, with group labels repeated at page boundaries.
Page size adapts to the surface, rotates on schedule, and balances the final page while preserving row order.
Portrait pagination reserves stacked full-width bands for direction and accessibility text without ellipsis, overflow, or type below 16px.
Datasource changes update visible department and room details in place.
An empty datasource still identifies the app and states why the surface is empty, in text legible at the declared viewing distance.

visualDirection.summary: A light-first campus reader board with civic wayfinding clarity, restrained academic character, and one continuous directory surface.
signatureChoices: A strong locator rail carries building and floor changes down the left edge of the continuous table.
Three campus-route colors form a compact orientation motif while accessibility uses a distinct, consistent marker.
avoid: Independent cards for each directory row.
A generic dashboard of floating panels or decorative gradients.

visualReview.intent: A calm, high-legibility campus directory whose grouped rows read in one stable top-to-bottom path at every requested surface.
focus: Verify group changes remain immediately visible without consuming excessive row width or repeating on every row.
Verify long department and accessibility text only loses its tail and never obscures room or direction information.
Verify the wide-low and square surfaces retain usable hierarchy rather than becoming compressed desktop layouts.
Verify partial pages distribute rows intentionally and all theme presets preserve sufficient contrast.
